measures.name: aedg_office_hvac_fan_coil_doas
measures.description: Measure replaces existing HVAC system (if any) with a Fan Coil with DOAS HVAC system (one DOAS per floor).  The fan coil with DOAS system (centralized DOAS, with zone level conditioning) is applied to all space types.  In select cases, the user is given the option to preserve existing HVAC schedules.  In other cases, new schedules are generated that align with AEDG recommendations.  The resulting HVAC system reflects the HVAC recommendations of the 50% Small and Medium Office AEDG.
measures.modeler_description: Airloops are dedicated to ventilation (DOAS) and have constant speed fan operation and hot and chilled water coils.  Conditioning is provided at the zone level with four pipe fan coils with cycling fan operation.  Chiller for DOAS and fan coils is air-cooled.

measures.name: aedg_office_hvac_vav_dx
measures.description: Measure replaces existing HVAC system (if any) with a high efficiency multizone variable air volume (VAV) HVAC system (one system per floor).  The multizone VAV system (centralized cooling with zone level heating) is applied to all space types.  In select cases, the user is given the option to preserve existing HVAC schedules.  In other cases, new schedules are generated that align with AEDG recommendations.  The resulting HVAC system reflects the HVAC recommendations of the 50% Small and Medium Office AEDG.
measures.modeler_description: Airloops are dedicated to the multizone VAV cooling system and have variable speed fan operation, hot water coil heating, and two speed DX cooling.  The cold deck has outdoor air reset on the supply air temperature.  Heating is provided at the zone level with hot water baseboard heaters.

measures.description: Add the selected Xcel utility rate, as well as set the timestep and lifecycle costing parameters as required by the Xcel EDA program.

These NIST numbers will not affect the Xcel EDA results.

measures.name: openstudio_results
measures.description: This measure creates high level tables and charts pulling both from model inputs and EnergyPlus results. It has building level information as well as detail on space types, thermal zones, HVAC systems, envelope characteristics, and economics. Click the heading above a chart to view a table of the chart data.
measures.modeler_description: For the most part consumption data comes from the tabular EnergyPlus results, however there are a few requests added for time series results. Space type and loop details come from the OpenStudio model. The code for this is modular, making it easy to use as a template for your own custom reports. The structure of the report uses bootstrap, and the graphs use dimple js.

steps.description: Measure replaces existing HVAC system (if any) with a Fan Coil with DOAS HVAC system (one DOAS per floor).  The fan coil with DOAS system (centralized DOAS, with zone level conditioning) is applied to all space types.  In select cases, the user is given the option to preserve existing HVAC schedules.
